# 360° environment backgrounds

All eight environments are **Poly Haven** HDRIs (https://polyhaven.com),
released under **CC0 1.0** (public domain). Each was downloaded from Poly
Haven's tonemapped 8K source and resized locally to 2K (2048×1024) and 1K
(1024×512) JPEGs for the low/high quality tiers. The picker thumbnails are the
official Poly Haven preview thumbnails.

| Local folder | Poly Haven HDRI | Author |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `comfy_cafe` | Comfy Café | Sergej Majboroda |
| `warm_bar` | Warm Bar | Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest |
| `billiard_hall` | Billiard Hall | Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest |
| `wooden_lounge` | Wooden Lounge | Greg Zaal |
| `warm_restaurant_night` | Warm Restaurant Night | Greg Zaal, Jarod Guest |
| `cayley_interior` | Cayley Interior | Greg Zaal |
| `fireplace` | Fireplace | Greg Zaal |
| `brown_photostudio_02` | Brown Photostudio 02 | Sergej Majboroda |
| `photo_studio_loft_hall` | Photo Studio Loft Hall | Sergej Majboroda |
| `blue_photo_studio` | Blue Photo Studio | Sergej Majboroda |
| `studio_country_hall` | Studio Country Hall | Sergej Majboroda |
| `venice_sunset` | Venice Sunset | Greg Zaal |
| `satara_night` | Satara Night | Greg Zaal |

These images are used as the game scene's equirectangular background and as
the PBR environment map (PMREM). No neon/artificial room geometry is shipped.
